referents.why: Interrogative 'What' (Τί γάρ) opening the question frame; no referent.
'Some' (τινες) is an indefinite group of people not named in this verse; no candidate is a person.
referents.category: indefinite group not offered as candidate

referents.why: 'Of them' (αὐτῶν) is the possessor of 'unbelief' and refers to the same unnamed 'some'; no candidate fits.

links.why: The condition is cl1 ('some disbelieved'); it conditions the question about nullifying (cl2), not the frame cl0. Direction is reversed.
No reason is stated; the εἰ clause conditions the consequence and gives no ground for the frame.
εἰ precedes the clause it governs: 'will their unbelief nullify (cl2), if some disbelieved (cl1)'.

groups.why: The condition is the εἰ clause cl1 and the consequence is the question about nullifying (cl2); cl0 is the 'What' frame and sits outside the conditional.
groups.category: condition and consequence across the question

cant_tell.what: cl0 and cl1 both carry the verb 'disbelieved'
cant_tell.why: The parser splits the εἰ clause into a frame carrying εἰ (cl0) and a copy of the verb (cl1). I took cl1 as the condition and cl0 as the frame; the form does not settle the split.
'For' (reason for verse 2) and 'then' (a question connective) are not separated by the form, so no link is added.
